sources.title: Alcohol (surface)
markers: | summary = a type of [[surface]] created by throwing or otherwise breaking a container of alcohol. It can be ignited or frozen.

summary: Provides 6 Camp Supplies or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. It can ignite or freeze.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Camp supplies: Provides 6 Camp Supplies for a Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: In the main Guildhall corner behind Tut Thistlebog.
